description: From the bay, Gijón's old town lights reflect in the moonlit water — the Cimadevilla quarter's glow spread along the shore with the harbor's masts dark against it. The moon silver-plates the bay while the town's lamps warm the waterfront. Asturias' great port city by night: old fishermen's quarter below, lights dancing on the Cantabrian Sea.
